tasks.title: Init Expo project
tasks.description: Run npx create-expo-app@latest mobile --template default@sdk-55 from repo root. Strip template boilerplate. Keep root _layout.tsx and single index.tsx.
tasks.validateCommand: cd mobile && npx expo start --no-dev --non-interactive 2>&1 | head -20
acceptanceCriteria: mobile/package.json contains expo ~55.0.0 and react-native 0.83.1
npx expo start launches without errors
Template boilerplate removed — single root layout + placeholder screen

tasks.title: Register in rush.json
tasks.description: Set mobile/package.json name to @hcengineering/mobile. Add rush.json entry with shouldPublish false. Run rush update.
acceptanceCriteria: rush.json has @hcengineering/mobile with shouldPublish false
rush update completes without errors
rush build -t @hcengineering/mobile runs

tasks.title: Add scaffold-safe Huly dependencies
tasks.description: Add @hcengineering/core and @hcengineering/platform as workspace:^ deps. Only scaffold-safe packages (no svelte, no tiptap chain).
acceptanceCriteria: @hcengineering/core and @hcengineering/platform in deps with workspace:^
rush update resolves without errors
import type { Doc, Ref } from @hcengineering/core compiles
Metro does not encounter svelte, tiptap, or Node.js module errors

tasks.title: Install and configure NativeWind v4
tasks.description: Install nativewind@^4.1.0, tailwindcss@^3.4.17, reanimated, safe-area-context. Create tailwind.config.ts, global.css, update metro.config.js with withNativeWind, update babel.config.js.
acceptanceCriteria: className bg-red-500 text-white p-4 renders on View/Text
metro.config.js uses withNativeWind wrapper
dark:bg-black applies when colorScheme is dark

tasks.title: Configure metro for monorepo
tasks.description: Extend metro.config.js: watchFolders for monorepo root, nodeModulesPaths for common/temp/node_modules, single React instance, resolverMainFields excluding svelte field, block server-only modules.
tasks.validateCommand: cd mobile && node -e "const m = require('./metro.config.js'); console.log('ok')"
acceptanceCriteria: import type Doc from @hcengineering/core resolves in Metro
No duplicate React or module resolution errors
Hot reload works on mobile/ file changes
Metro does not resolve svelte field from @hcengineering/* package.json files

tasks.title: Create @hcengineering/mobile-design-tokens shared package
tasks.description: Create packages/mobile-design-tokens/ as shared Rush package. Zero deps, plain TS as-const objects. Port Huly design tokens from _colors.scss and _vars.scss. Register in rush.json with shouldPublish true.
acceptanceCriteria: rush.json has @hcengineering/mobile-design-tokens entry
rush update && rush build -t @hcengineering/mobile-design-tokens succeeds
import { colors, spacing } from @hcengineering/mobile-design-tokens works
Package has zero dependencies

tasks.title: Wire design tokens into mobile tailwind config
tasks.description: Add @hcengineering/mobile-design-tokens as workspace:^ dep. Import tokens into tailwind.config.ts theme.extend. Zero hardcoded values.
acceptanceCriteria: tailwind.config.ts imports from @hcengineering/mobile-design-tokens, zero hardcoded values
bg-surface renders #161719 in dark mode
bg-primary renders #205DC2

tasks.title: Bundle IBM Plex Sans fonts
tasks.description: Download IBM Plex Sans TTF files. Place in mobile/assets/fonts/. Load with useFonts() in root layout. Add fontFamily to tailwind.config.ts.
acceptanceCriteria: font-sans renders IBM Plex Sans Regular on both platforms
font-sans-bold renders IBM Plex Sans Bold
Fonts load before splash screen hides

tasks.title: Create scaffold directory structure
tasks.description: Create convention-compliant directory structure with tsconfig.json. Dirs: client, repositories, hooks, store, components/ui, components/features, lib, theme, test. Route groups: (auth), (app).
acceptanceCriteria: All convention directories exist (client, repositories, hooks, store, components/ui, components/features, lib)
tsconfig.json has strict true, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, path alias @/*
npx tsc --noEmit passes

tasks.title: Create placeholder app with Huly styling
tasks.description: Wire everything: root layout with dark theme, SafeAreaProvider, font loading, splash screen. Index screen with Huly dark bg, IBM Plex Sans, primary blue accent.
acceptanceCriteria: App launches: dark bg #161719, white text IBM Plex Sans, blue #205DC2 accent
Dark/light theme toggle works via useColorScheme
No yellow box warnings or red screen errors
